newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ govt surplus above forecast in 7 months to Jan.
newsitem.headline: NZ govt surplus above forecast in 7 months to Jan.

text.p: The New Zealand government said on Friday it posted a NZ$1.685 billion operating budget surplus for the seven months to January 31, 1997, against a forecast surplus of $1.455 billion.
Net public debt as a percentage of GDP was 28.9 percent at January 31 against 29.1 percent at December 31, 1996.
Treasury said the year-to-date improvement in the operating balance over the forecast had reduced by about $100 million in January, primarily due to tax revenue moving closer to expectations.

Net public debt was $378 million lower than forecast at $26.583 billion, mainly due to less than forecast purchase of assets (primarily timing difference on the purchase of military equipment) and stronger than forecast net cashflows.
